WITH station_avgs AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg 
  FROM telescopes 
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL 
  GROUP BY observstation
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(station_avg) as baseline_val
  FROM station_avgs
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT sa.station_avg, b.baseline_val
  FROM station_avgs sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_val
)
SELECT 
  AVG(station_avg) as mean_of_above_baseline_stations,
  AVG(station_avg - baseline_val) as mean_excess_over_baseline
FROM above_baseline
